# System map

MASTER-QA-PROTOCOL §5.1. What exists, so a tester knows what to cover.

## Roles

Two, and that is the whole list.

| Role | How it is established | Reaches |
|---|---|---|
| Public | nothing — there are no customer accounts | everything except `/admin` |
| Admin | single password → httpOnly signed cookie (`src/lib/admin-auth.ts`) | `/admin`, and the admin verbs below |

There are **no subscription tiers, no plan entitlements and no customer login**. Guest checkout only; an order is looked up by **order id + phone**, which is therefore the entire authorisation model for customer data.

## Integrations

| Service | Used for | Failure surface |
|---|---|---|
| Stripe | checkout sessions, webhook | `/api/checkout`, `/api/stripe-webhook` |
| Supabase (self-hosted Postgres) | all persistence, via service role | every DB-backed route |
| Resend | order and status email | `src/lib/email.ts` |
| Umami | analytics, proxied first-party at `/stats` | `src/components/Analytics.tsx` |
| Sentry / GlitchTip | error reporting, and uptime alerts | `SENTRY_DSN` |
| WhatsApp | order notifications | `src/lib/whatsapp.ts` |
